text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's debut race has finally 
arrived. In the stands are T.M. Opera O 
and Meisho Doto—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Narita Top Road had come to watch. The 
cheers of the three uniquely charming 
classmates resounded through the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega, however, paid it no heed, 
remaining focused solely on the race and 
the mission she had to fulfill there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's heart throbbed. It was proof 
that the faint remnant of her little 
sister inside her had begun to tremble 
with joy and anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To satisfy her sister... She would 
definitely seize victory. With resolve in 
her heart, Admire Vega ran.
